pages.text: There are $(l)abandoned laboratories$() out in the plains and forests: stone walls, a fallen roof, a dead organism in its frame, a Dissection Table with no brain. Someone did this before me.$(br2)Their chests still hold scraps of the work, and very rarely a blueprint that survived.

pages.title: Faded Blueprints
pages.text: On their tables lie $(l)faded blueprints$(), illegible now and too brittle to carry. Through the Lens, at Decades, the lines come back. Hold the view on one for two seconds and I can copy it into this journal.$(br2)A copied blueprint is a $(l)clue$(): the Chronocortex accepts it in place of the experiments it would otherwise ask for.
